openDecisions.question: Bulk selection ships in code but has no design. Design it as an Acme DS pattern, or remove it from this release?

options.label: Design it (Acme DS pattern)
options.consequence: Designer adds a select column and bulk-action bar to Acme DS; code swaps BulkActionBar for the DS component. About 3 days of design and 1 of code; the feature stays.

options.label: Remove it for now
options.consequence: Delete BulkActionBar and the select-all control; ship without bulk actions. Parity is restored today and the feature returns with its own ticket.

openDecisions.recommendation: Design it. The component already works and other list pages (Customers, Invoices) need the same pattern. Keep it behind the orders-bulk flag until the Acme DS version lands.

openDecisions.question: Pagination: keep it in the toolbar (as built) or move it below the table (as designed)? Resolved on 2026-09-18.

options.label: Keep it in the toolbar (as built)
options.consequence: Page controls stay above the fold on 12-row pages; the Figma frame needs an update.

options.label: Move it below the table (as designed)
options.consequence: Matches the frame; page controls fall below the fold at 900px viewport height.

openDecisions.recommendation: Keep as built: signed off by Product on 2026-09-18 (DQ-011). Update the Figma frame so the next pass compares like with like.
